name: trirelay
description: Host-symmetric multi-agent orchestration relay connecting Antigravity (agy), Claude Code (claude), and OpenAI Codex (codex) with zero-dep async MCP, sub-50ms SessionStart snapshots, 3-tier memory, and isolated git worktrees.

scripts.check: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs => { const { execFileSync } = await import('node:child_process'); const walk = (d) => fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() && e.name !== 'node_modules' && e.name !== '.git' ? walk(d + '/' + e.name) : e.name.endsWith('.mjs') ? [d + '/' + e.name] : []); for (const f of walk('.')) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' }); })"
